description: Render the project's business card as one self-contained HTML page a person can read or screenshot. Front: name, title, one-liner. Flip it for the back: About, Skills (when the .fafa lists any), Context (AGENTS.md), Memory, Discovery. layout:"portrait" for the tall view; expanded:true renders both faces flat with every section open. Also served at GET /card (?expand=all) over the HTTP transport.

accent.description: CSS hex colour, e.g. #0066cc (default: the .fafa metadata.cards.accent, else black/white ink)

expanded.description: render every AGENTS.md section open (default: collapsed)

name: render_context_card
title: Render Context Card
